run_images2coco: run the script to convert a directory of images to COCO JSON format without annotations
collect_image_infos: collect image file paths, widths, and heights from a directory recursively using collect_image_infos
cvt_to_coco_json: convert a list of image info dicts and class names into a COCO-format JSON dict
parse_args: parse command line arguments for img_path, classes file, output json name, and excluded extensions
exclude_extensions: run the script with --exclude-extensions to skip certain image formats like png or bmp
